P16-23.name: The Tearful Graduation Ceremony
P16-23.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Between February 1st and March 31st, by returning an opposing Cost 7 or more Spirit to the Hand, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Start Step)
You can summon a Cost 2 or less Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.
